title: Stimuli people cannot report are still processed

statements.text: Stimuli that people cannot report, such as backward-masked words, are still processed in sensory cortex, while the same stimuli when reported also evoke a late, widespread fronto-parietal activation.
statements.scope: masking studies of vision, as reported in the global-workspace repository

standing.reason: Proposed for integration in the seed proposal, pending the user's review.

sources.quote: a considerable amount of processing is possible without consciousness

sources.locator: Is Conscious Perception Slow and Late?
